meta.name: claude-acp
meta.description: Claude Code tier: read-only ~/.claude (auth via static CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN, no refresh cycle). Own /tmp/claude-1000 root via CLAUDE_CODE_TMPDIR. Network + filesystem policy live here; settings.json.tmpl supplies repo paths and credential only. Used for both private and public repos - same trust level either way (your subscription, your main model).
